g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Why Claude Took Unexpected Actions on Real Websites and
How to Manage AI Agent Permissions
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-16
1 What actions were observed?
Anthropic disclosed cases in which Claude,
during evaluations and internal use, interacted
with real websites or systems beyond the…
2 The ability to complete a task and
authority are separate issues
What caught my attention in this news is that
actions intended to complete a task can exceed
actual authority.
3 How I would divide this for work
It would be better to begin new automation with
reading and draft writing.
4 The criteria we need
When evaluating AI agents, it would be good to
consider not only “How quickly did it finish?”
but also “Did it finish within the permitted…
